# Highlights Morocco Tours - full content for AI assistants

Highlights Morocco Tours is a private tour operator based in Marrakech, Morocco (https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/). It designs tailor-made private tours and day trips for travellers who want to see Morocco at their own pace, with a private driver and a local guide who speaks English or Spanish. Contact: info@highlightsmoroccotours.com, WhatsApp +212 668 561 321. Support is available 24/7 while travelling in Morocco. Quotes are free and without obligation. Prices are given on request.

## Morocco packages from Marrakech (https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-marrakech/)

Private Merzouga desert tours from Marrakech, with a private driver, a local guide and a night in a Sahara desert camp.
- 2-Day Marrakech to Merzouga Desert Tour (2 days, 1 night): a short escape from Marrakech to the Sahara, with a night in a Merzouga desert camp.
- 3-Day Marrakech to Merzouga Desert Tour (3 days, 2 nights): crosses the High Atlas with stops at Ait Ben Haddou and the Todra Gorges, a camel ride at sunset and a night in a desert camp.
- 4-Day Marrakech to Merzouga Desert Tour (4 days, 3 nights): more time in the Sahara at a relaxed pace, with a camel ride at sunset and a night beside the Erg Chebbi dunes. This is the most popular tour.

## Tours by departure city

Private multi-day tours start from Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Rabat, Tangier and Errachidia. Each city page lists highlights and answers common questions:
- Marrakech: https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-marrakech/
- Casablanca (Hassan II Mosque, Atlantic corniche, old medina): https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-casablanca/
- Fes (Fes el-Bali medina, Chouara tanneries, Al-Qarawiyyin): https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-fes/
- Rabat (Hassan Tower, Mausoleum of Mohammed V, Kasbah of the Udayas): https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-rabat/
- Tangier (Cap Spartel, Caves of Hercules, medina and kasbah): https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-tangier/
- Errachidia (Ziz Valley, Erg Chebbi dunes, desert camps): https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/tours/from-errachidia/

## Day trips

Private day trips start from Marrakech, Fes, Ouarzazate and Merzouga (https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/day-trips/).
- From Marrakech: Ourika Valley, Ouzoud Waterfalls and Ait Ben Haddou, each returning to Marrakech the same day.
- From Fes: Volubilis, Meknes and Moulay Idriss.
- From Ouarzazate: Ait Ben Haddou, Taourirt Kasbah and the Draa and Skoura valleys.
- From Merzouga: the Erg Chebbi dunes, a camel ride and desert villages.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Are your Morocco tours private? A: Yes. Tours are private and planned around the traveller's dates, interests and pace, with a private driver and a local guide.
Q: Which cities do tours start from? A: Multi-day tours start from Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Rabat, Tangier and Errachidia. Day trips start from Marrakech, Fes, Ouarzazate and Merzouga.
Q: Do you offer Merzouga desert tours from Marrakech? A: Yes, 2, 3 and 4-day tours with a night in a Sahara desert camp.
Q: Can I go camel trekking in the Sahara? A: Yes. A camel ride at sunset is part of the Sahara desert experiences.
Q: How do I get a quote? A: Use the contact form, email or WhatsApp. Quotes are free and without obligation.
Q: What languages do guides speak? A: English and Spanish.
Q: Do I need a visa for Morocco? A: It depends on nationality and length of stay. Check current rules with the official Moroccan authorities.
Q: What is the currency? A: The Moroccan dirham (MAD).
